entries.7ef069214c41ccf9: The company is pursuing a three-year medium-term management plan, 'Medium-Term Management Plan 2027', with fiscal 2027 as its goal. Its three basic policies are improving business profitability, updating the management foundation, and contributing to the sustained maintenance of transportation infrastructure in local communities. Its long-term vision, 'Vision 2030', sets out as its aspired image 'an advanced corporate group that creates a new harmony among people, local communities and mobility', and cites expansion of its business domains through digital-enabled mobility-related services and expansion into adjacent businesses.
